newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines phone co says losing on illegal calls.
newsitem.headline: Philippines phone co says losing on illegal calls.

text.p: The Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co said on Tuesday it is losing a billion pesos in annual revenues due to what it said is an illegal international calling scheme.

PLDT manager for quality control Noel Florido told a news conference that the International Simple Resale (ISR) scheme allowed an ISR operator to connect international calls directly to domestic exchange facilities, bypassing the international gateway facilities of the countries involved.

PLDT said Filipinos in the United States were being lured to subscribe to telecommunications cooperatives providing ISR services. The rates were cheaper by 40 cents per minute compared to calls made through legitimate IGF operators.
The PLDT official said the National Bureau of Investigation raided and closed down nine companies providing ISR services in the last two months.
